svg.title: VOLTRA Thermal Lab: annotated real prototype
svg.desc: Nine numbered callouts identify visible components and explain typical purposes, with unverified functions explicitly marked. The owner-supplied photograph is embedded without alteration. Leader lines are not a wiring schematic.
svg.text: READ THE PHOTO, NOT AN ASSUMED CIRCUIT
Purpose notes describe typical component roles, not demonstrated operation.
Cooling method, GPIO map, pump flow and controller behavior remain unverified.
Leader lines identify parts; they are not electrical or fluid connections.
